sources.quote: COAT-ZN-YELLOW,Zinc 8 um with yellow chromate passivation,Zinc;CrVI
so a coating containing hexavalent chromium may not be used on our parts.

findings.why: The proposed yellow chromate passivation (COAT-ZN-YELLOW) contains hexavalent chromium. The end-of-life vehicle rules ban it, and the ban continues under Regulation (EU) 2026/1738. The excerpt gives the replacement regulation's date as 1 September 2028, but it also says to check the Official Journal text before quoting dates.

sources.quote: Nonconformance report NCR-26-017. Supplier: Minuterie Germanasca (SUP-G). Status: open.
Lot 26-0412 of CL-115 clips in C67S spring steel measured 52 HRC, tolerance 44-50 HRC.

findings.why: The source of CL-115, SUP-G, has an open NCR on the C67S spring steel of this part. A lot measured 52 HRC against a 44-50 HRC tolerance.
